acceptanceCriteria: A supported optional operator route reports installed and available Core and standalone Tasks versions using their applicable release channels; absence of network/evidence reports freshness UNKNOWN.

The apply route verifies archive and internal checksums, retains manifests/licenses/qualification limits, checks host compatibility, preserves stores and prior binaries, and supports rollback without silently downgrading newer verified local builds.
Component selection does not assume the newest release contains both Core and Tasks, and does not describe developer build/version smoke evidence as full qualification.
Retain focused tests and actual macOS upgrade/rollback evidence for checksum failures, unavailable releases, interrupted downloads and compatibility refusals; preserve the network-free Core boundary.
body:
Observed on this machine 2026-09-29: PATH held Core rc.1 build 163 and Tasks build 163, while official standalone Tasks developer release tasks-dev-20260929.2 provides build 202. docs/INSTALL.md describes manual versioned installation and rollback; no supported update-check/apply command or existing updater was found. The owner requests latest versions machine-wide and automatic tasks for observed gaps. This setup installed the published archives with checksum verification and retained rollback binaries; global agent instructions and a separate Codex heartbeat can maintain this one machine. Propose reusable optional operator tooling outside the network-free Core for checking both official component channels. Related distribution work: V1-0422. This is a product gap/proposal, not a confirmed runtime defect; publisher identity and Tasks full runtime qualification remain unobserved.

2026-09-29 implementation evidence: clean source commit 136862c40d023d6f45b439650f51704b3d37dddc on codex/v1-0505-updater, draft PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/383. Optional experimental corvint-update is installed at /Users/russelllewis/.local/bin/corvint-update; retained installation/notices and verified installed receipts are under /Users/russelllewis/.local/share/corvint/updater/136862c40d023d6f45b439650f51704b3d37dddc. Existing daily 09:00 heartbeat keep-machine-corvint-current now checks/applies both components using the helper. Core rc.1 build 163 and Tasks developer build 202 matched official archive/internal checksums in unchanged activation. Focused tests/vet, spec/docs checks, independent review (four acceptance criteria PASS), actual macOS Tasks upgrade/exact rollback, interruption/checksum/compatibility witnesses, and clean post-CEM dogfood check/seal passed. See docs/build-log/2026-09-29-operator-updater.md and docs/specs/operator-update-v0.md in the branch. Full repository gate and unrelated retrieval evaluations NOT_RUN under scoped policy; affected scope UNKNOWN; existing SOP OCM clauses unassessed. Native final claim refused RESOURCE_COLLISION with attempt:corvint:main:e3046796bd46c1299bf1bcf2984bdac8. No conflicting lease or policy changed. Ticket stays OPEN: landing requires owner merge approval, then admission/submit/required native gates/completion must succeed; local installation and CEM sealing alone do not close it.
title: distribution: check and apply compatible Core and Tasks updates with rollback
